children: TOKYO--Japan's Ministry of Finance said Tuesday it is auctioning Y2.6 trillion of 10-Year government bonds.

Issue                   10-year govt bond (No 38393 reopened) 
Coupon                                                   2.7% 
Settlement Date                                   Sep 2, 2026 
Maturity Date                                    Jun 20, 2036 
Offer Amount                                    Y2.6 Trillion
